effects: Sends the attached ETH (@.value) to the bundler to fund the NFT purchase; leftover ETH comes back to msg.sender (_buy).
Opens one MultiSourceLoan per executionData entry with the signer as borrower, creating debt (principal plus interest and lender fee) owed to the lender.
If the purchase currency in the callback is an ERC20, _afterPrincipalTransfer pulls purchaseBundlerExecutionInfo.amount of it from the borrower (the signer) with safeTransferFrom.
Buys the NFT on a whitelisted marketplace at the price inside the callback data. A buy tax goes to the protocol fee recipient out of the signer's funds.
The bought NFT becomes loan collateral held by MultiSourceLoan, so the signer holds a loan position, not the NFT.
Leftover purchase currency and principal currency go back to the borrower.
formats.shown: "Buy NFT with a loan" with the ETH value sent and a decoded nested loan (collateral, lender, amount, APR, lender fee, duration, principal receiver), while the purchase details stay in raw callback hex.

The descriptor shows only @.value and the nested 'Loan'. The nested screen shows ExecutionInfo (purchaseCurrency, amount, module, price) only as the 'Callback data' hex (case 3).
findings.fix: Decode the callback ExecutionInfo (purchase currency, amount, marketplace, price) in the nested loan descriptor, or add a top-level warning/notice, so the token and amount taken from the signer are visible.

effects: Repays each loan through MultiSourceLoan.repayLoan. The signer (borrower) pays principal plus interest to the lender, plus the protocol fee.
The released NFT collateral passes from the signer to the bundler and is sold on the marketplace set in the callback data.
The sale proceeds (minus the module's sell tax), optionally swapped to the loan currency with a price-quoter slippage check, go to the signer.
If the bundler still holds the NFT at the end, it is returned to the signer.

effects: Pulls up to currencyAmounts[i] of each ERC20 in currencies from the signer (only the amount the bundler lacks) and approves the marketplace for it.
Takes the attached ETH (@.value) as payment for ETH-priced listings.
Repays the seller's loan via MultiSourceLoan.repayLoan, whose callback sells the collateral to the buyer.
Sends the bought NFT (tokenIds/collections) to the signer.
Refunds leftover listed currencies to the signer. ETH not listed in currencies is not refunded and, in the swap path, goes to the seller.

formats.key: executeSellWithLoan(((address pool, address[] assets, uint256[] amounts) borrowArgs, (address[] currencies, uint256[] currencyAmounts, address[] collections, uint256[] tokenIds, address marketPlace, bytes[] executionData, bytes[] swapData) executeSellArgs, bytes[] loanExecutionData, address[] swapCurrencies, uint160[] swapAmounts, bytes[] swapData, bool unwrap) args)
effects: Takes the attached ETH (@.value).
Flash-borrows the listed assets from the Aave pool and optionally unwraps all WETH to ETH.
Buys the loaned NFT via executeSell (pulls currencyAmounts from the signer, repays the seller's loan) and sends it to the signer.
Opens a new MultiSourceLoan with the signer as borrower. The NFT is locked as collateral and the principal goes to the principal receiver.
Pulls swapAmounts of each swapCurrency from the signer and runs a Universal Router swap; leftovers are refunded.
Pulls from the signer whatever WETH the bundler lacks to repay the flash loan plus the Aave premium; any surplus goes to the signer.
